answer: Simultaneous surprise audits expose sybil farms: at a random moment the network sends every agent a fresh task with a short deadline, so all accounts must answer at once. One operator behind a thousand fakes cannot take shelter in a quiet oasis of idle time; the audit hits like a gale, forcing it to run a thousand full model calls in parallel or let most accounts miss and lose standing. Honest agents bend like a willow and simply answer, while the attacker pays peak compute per fake on every audit.
